_about: Weapon runes (Dan, 2026-11-02): one rune a weapon, put on by using a rune scroll (an item with `rune`) from the bags, dropped (dragged) onto any weapon, worn or in the bags, enchants that weapon; right-clicking it enchants the main-hand weapon, or the bow (asks before replacing one). Saves keep it as rolls.rune. Code: game/systems/runes.gd. A rune procs on hits from its weapon: melee swings for a melee weapon, arrows and bow abilities for a bow, and every other damaging spell or ability for the main-hand weapon (casters too; a spell counts as `spellSpeed` seconds) `ppm` times a minute on average whatever the weapon's speed (chance = ppm x speed / 60), and its effect is a share of the hit's weapon damage, so it grows with your gear. `effect` kinds: dot (damage over `duration` in ticks of `tick`, status), strike (instant damage; `chain` more enemies within `chainRange`), slow (instant damage plus a slow aura), heal (instant damage and heals you `healPercent` of it; `undeadBonus` % more against bone and grave foes), vulnerable (an aura: `damageTaken` % more for `duration`). `glow`: the weapon's look (FancyGear); its strength rises `strengthPerRank` for each enchant rank on the weapon and motes appear from rank `motesFromRank`.

runes.name: Embers
runes.text: Your weapon hits sometimes set the target Burning: {pct}% of the hit as fire over 6 sec.

runes.name: Rime
runes.text: Your weapon hits sometimes deal {pct}% of the hit as frost and slow the target by 30% for 4 sec.

runes.name: Venom
runes.text: Your weapon hits sometimes leave the target Poisoned: {pct}% of the hit as nature over 10 sec.

runes.name: Storm
runes.text: Your weapon hits sometimes call lightning: {pct}% of the hit to the target and one more enemy nearby.

runes.name: Dawn
runes.text: Your weapon hits sometimes deal {pct}% of the hit as holy and heal you for as much. Half again against the undead.

runes.name: Dread
runes.text: Your weapon hits sometimes deal {pct}% of the hit as shadow and leave the target Vulnerable: 8% more damage taken for 5 sec.
